INSERT INTO public.payment_events (gateway, event_id, event_type, raw_payload, processed)
VALUES (
  'lastlink',
  '{{$json.event_id}}',
  '{{$json.event_type}}',
  '{{$json.raw_payload}}'::jsonb,
  false
)
ON CONFLICT (gateway, event_id) DO NOTHING
RETURNING id;

INSERT INTO public.users (phone, name, email, status, created_from)
VALUES (
  '{{ $('📦 Normalizar Payload').item.json.buyer_phone.replace(/\D/g, '') }}',
  {{$('📦 Normalizar Payload').item.json.buyer_name ? `'${$('📦 Normalizar Payload').item.json.buyer_name.replace(/'/g, "''")}'` : 'NULL'}},
  {{$('📦 Normalizar Payload').item.json.buyer_email ? `'${$('📦 Normalizar Payload').item.json.buyer_email}'` : 'NULL'}},
  'true',
  'lastlink'
)
ON CONFLICT (phone) DO UPDATE
  SET name   = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.name, users.name),
      email  = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.email, users.email),
      status = 'true'
RETURNING phone;

INSERT INTO public.subscriptions
  (user_phone, gateway, gateway_subscription_id, offer_id, offer_name,
   product_id, product_name, status, amount, started_at, valid_until, gateway_meta)
VALUES (
  '{{ $('📦 Normalizar Payload').item.json.buyer_phone.replace(/\D/g, '') }}',
  'lastlink',
  {{$('📦 Normalizar Payload').item.json.gateway_subscription_id ? `'${$('📦 Normalizar Payload').item.json.gateway_subscription_id}'` : 'NULL'}},
  {{$('📦 Normalizar Payload').item.json.offer_id ? `'${$('📦 Normalizar Payload').item.json.offer_id}'` : 'NULL'}},
  {{$('📦 Normalizar Payload').item.json.offer_name ? `'${$('📦 Normalizar Payload').item.json.offer_name.replace(/'/g, "''")}'` : 'NULL'}},
  {{$('📦 Normalizar Payload').item.json.product_id ? `'${$('📦 Normalizar Payload').item.json.product_id}'` : 'NULL'}},
  {{$('📦 Normalizar Payload').item.json.product_name ? `'${$('📦 Normalizar Payload').item.json.product_name.replace(/'/g, "''")}'` : 'NULL'}},
  'active',
  {{$('📦 Normalizar Payload').item.json.amount ?? 'NULL'}},
  NOW(),
  {{$('📦 Normalizar Payload').item.json.valid_until_calculated ? `'${$('📦 Normalizar Payload').item.json.valid_until_calculated}'` : 'NULL'}},
  '{"source":"lastlink"}'::jsonb
)
ON CONFLICT (user_phone)
  DO UPDATE SET
    status                  = 'active',
    gateway_subscription_id = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.gateway_subscription_id, subscriptions.gateway_subscription_id),
    offer_id                = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.offer_id, subscriptions.offer_id),
    offer_name              = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.offer_name, subscriptions.offer_name),
    product_id              = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.product_id, subscriptions.product_id),
    product_name            = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.product_name, subscriptions.product_name),
    valid_until             = EXCLUDED.valid_until,
    amount                  = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.amount, subscriptions.amount),
    gateway_meta            = EXCLUDED.gateway_meta,
    updated_at              = NOW()
RETURNING id;

INSERT INTO public.payments
  (user_phone, subscription_id, gateway, gateway_payment_id, event_type,
   amount, original_amount, currency, payment_method, installments,
   recurrency_number, paid_at, utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign,
   affiliate_id, affiliate_email)
VALUES (
  '{{ $('📦 Normalizar Payload').item.json.buyer_phone.replace(/\D/g, '') }}',
  {{$json.id ? `'${$json.id}'` : 'NULL'}},
  'lastlink',
  {{$('📦 Normalizar Payload').item.json.gateway_payment_id ? `'${$('📦 Normalizar Payload').item.json.gateway_payment_id}'` : 'NULL'}},
  '{{$('📦 Normalizar Payload').item.json.normalized_event_type}}',
  {{$('📦 Normalizar Payload').item.json.amount ?? 'NULL'}},
  {{$('📦 Normalizar Payload').item.json.original_amount ?? 'NULL'}},
  'BRL',
  {{$('📦 Normalizar Payload').item.json.payment_method ? `'${$('📦 Normalizar Payload').item.json.payment_method}'` : 'NULL'}},
  {{$('📦 Normalizar Payload').item.json.installments ?? 1}},
  {{$('📦 Normalizar Payload').item.json.recurrency_number ?? 1}},
  {{$('📦 Normalizar Payload').item.json.paid_at ? `'${$('📦 Normalizar Payload').item.json.paid_at}'` : 'NULL'}},
  {{$('📦 Normalizar Payload').item.json.utm_source ? `'${$('📦 Normalizar Payload').item.json.utm_source}'` : 'NULL'}},
  {{$('📦 Normalizar Payload').item.json.utm_medium ? `'${$('📦 Normalizar Payload').item.json.utm_medium}'` : 'NULL'}},
  {{$('📦 Normalizar Payload').item.json.utm_campaign ? `'${$('📦 Normalizar Payload').item.json.utm_campaign}'` : 'NULL'}},
  {{$('📦 Normalizar Payload').item.json.affiliate_id ? `'${$('📦 Normalizar Payload').item.json.affiliate_id}'` : 'NULL'}},
  {{$('📦 Normalizar Payload').item.json.affiliate_email ? `'${$('📦 Normalizar Payload').item.json.affiliate_email}'` : 'NULL'}}
)
RETURNING id;

SELECT id FROM public.subscriptions
WHERE gateway = 'lastlink'
  AND gateway_subscription_id = '{{$('📦 Normalizar Payload').item.json.gateway_subscription_id}}'
LIMIT 1;

-- CANCELAMENTO: valid_until NÃO é alterado.
-- O usuário continua com acesso até o fim do período que já pagou.
UPDATE public.subscriptions
SET
  status              = 'canceled',
  canceled_at         = {{$('📦 Normalizar Payload').item.json.canceled_date ? `'${$('📦 Normalizar Payload').item.json.canceled_date}'` : 'NOW()'}},
  cancellation_reason = {{$('📦 Normalizar Payload').item.json.cancellation_reason ? `'${$('📦 Normalizar Payload').item.json.cancellation_reason.replace(/'/g, "''")}'` : 'NULL'}},
  updated_at          = NOW()
  -- valid_until preservado: usuário usa até o fim do período pago
WHERE id = '{{$('🔍 Buscar Subscription Cancel').item.json.id}}'
RETURNING id, valid_until;

INSERT INTO public.payments (user_phone, subscription_id, gateway, event_type, amount, currency)
VALUES (
  '{{$('📦 Normalizar Payload').item.json.buyer_phone}}',
  {{$('🔍 Buscar Subscription Cancel').item.json.id ? `'${$('🔍 Buscar Subscription Cancel').item.json.id}'` : 'NULL'}},
  'lastlink',
  'canceled',
  {{$('📦 Normalizar Payload').item.json.amount ?? 'NULL'}},
  'BRL'
)
RETURNING id;

-- EXPIRAÇÃO: assinatura encerrou por não renovação
UPDATE public.subscriptions
SET
  status     = 'expired',
  expired_at = NOW(),
  updated_at = NOW()
WHERE gateway = 'lastlink'
  AND gateway_subscription_id = '{{$('📦 Normalizar Payload').item.json.gateway_subscription_id}}'
RETURNING id;

-- REEMBOLSO/CHARGEBACK: corta acesso imediatamente.
-- valid_until = CURRENT_DATE garante que a view active_subscriptions
-- não retorna mais esse usuário a partir de hoje.
UPDATE public.subscriptions
SET
  status      = '{{$('📦 Normalizar Payload').item.json.normalized_event_type === 'chargeback' ? 'chargeback' : 'refunded'}}',
  valid_until = CURRENT_DATE,
  updated_at  = NOW()
WHERE gateway = 'lastlink'
  AND gateway_subscription_id = '{{$('📦 Normalizar Payload').item.json.gateway_subscription_id}}'
RETURNING id;

INSERT INTO public.payments

  {{$('📦 Normalizar Payload').item.json.chargeback_at ? `'${$('📦 Normalizar Payload').item.json.chargeback_at}'` : 'NULL'}}
